C-EXPORT-SETTINGS-SECTION.Name: Export without the settings modal: an Export section in Preferences owns the parameters (the C-EXPORT-SINGLE-PAGE form relocated); PDF/HTML export becomes one click like Word; the post-export notice opens the section
C-EXPORT-SETTINGS-SECTION.Summary: The backlog item recorded 2026-10-23 (owner proposal on the DOCX spec review): remove the pre-export settings modal entirely — Word already ships modal-less — move its parameters into a dedicated Export section of app settings, and make every export one click (menu → save dialog) using the remembered options, exactly as the ⌘P print path already does. The single-page form shipped by C-EXPORT-SINGLE-PAGE (sections, hydration from remembered options, margin presets, header/footer strips, Reset) is the content that relocates into that section. The post-export notification balloon already carries the quiet "Export settings" action; it retargets from opening the dialog to opening Preferences at the Export section. This change executes after C-EXPORT-SINGLE-PAGE is merged (same files, strictly sequential).

Problem.Description: The modal is friction in the common case: options are remembered, most exports are a bare "OK" click, and a third format triples the ceremony. Export parameters live in a modal users meet only mid-task instead of where they look for settings. Word and ⌘P already prove the modal-less shape; PDF and HTML are the remaining ceremony.

Goals.R-1: Export section in Preferences (Settings window): the C-EXPORT-SINGLE-PAGE form relocates there — same sections, same hydration, same Reset — as a first-class settings section (⌘, › Export); saving semantics follow the settings-window convention (immediate apply to the remembered options store, no Export button).
Goals.R-2: One-click export everywhere: File › Export to PDF / Export as HTML / Export as Word, the tab-menu export group and the titlebar popover row (C-DOC-POPOVER-EXPORT-HUB) all go straight to the save dialog with the remembered options; the pre-export modal is removed from all flows; the export bus payload shape is unchanged.
Goals.R-3: Post-export notice: the existing quiet "Export settings" action opens Preferences at the Export section (all three formats' notices); the correction loop wrong-output → button → section → fix → re-export completes without any modal.
Goals.R-4: Escape hatch deferred by design: one-off per-export overrides are a conscious v1 loss (⌥-click "Export with settings…" is the recorded v1.5 candidate, not in this change); the section's Reset remains the way back to factory defaults.
Goals.R-5: Tests and locales: store/unit coverage that each export command skips the dialog and rides remembered options (Word precedent pattern); e2e print/export specs updated to the new invoke order (command → save dialog → write; the settings dialog never opens for any format); ten locales gain the section title; dead dialog-title keys removed.

Constraints.Item: Strictly after C-EXPORT-SINGLE-PAGE merges (same component and store files; single-writer discipline).
REMEMBER_EXPORT_OPTIONS persistence semantics unchanged (the section writes the same remembered store); no new IPC or capabilities; Preferences opens via the existing settings entry points.
The bus 'export' payload stays byte-compatible; ⌘P print path untouched.
Baseline grace lint current = 0; final assertions with commands; graph/verification updates ride the existing export modules (M-072 retarget) rather than new anchors.

NonGoals.Item: New export parameters (Word base font, static TOC toggle, PDF header/footer templates stay the recorded later candidates); print (⌘P) changes; the mobile viewer.
Syncing export settings across machines or profiles.

AffectedAreas.Item: src/renderer/src/components/exportSettings/ (form relocates into prefComponents; the dialog shell and its bus showExportDialog surface are removed), src/renderer/src/prefComponents/ (Export section)
src/renderer/src/commands/index.js + store/editor.js (pdf/html export actions go modal-less like EXPORT_DOCX_DOCUMENT; quiet action retarget)
static/locales/*.json (ten locales: section title, dead keys removed)
tests/renderer/** (dialog suites relocate with the form; store dispatch tests), tests/e2e/print-export.spec.ts + export-office.spec.ts (expectation updates: no settings dialog on any flow)
.grace/graph/features.xml M-072 + .grace/verification/features.xml V-M-072 (retarget to the section surface)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-1..R-5 done; full vitest green; both export e2e specs green with the updated no-dialog expectations; grace lint 0 at close.

Live check on macOS (owner): every export (menu, tab menu, popover) goes file straight to the save dialog and produces identical output to a pre-change export with the same remembered options; ⌘, › Export shows the section with last-used values; the notice button lands on the section; wrong-orientation loop fixed without ever seeing a modal.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Unit: modal-less dispatch for pdf/styledHtml mirrors the Word precedent; section hydration/reset coverage relocated intact. E2e: invoke order save-dialog-first for all formats, zero settings-dialog mounts. Owner smoke incl. the notice-button correction loop.

Assumptions.Assumption: The settings window supports opening at a section (or gains it cheaply) for the notice-button retarget; if not, the button opens Settings and the section is first — acceptable v1.
Immediate-apply semantics in the section are acceptable for export parameters (they only affect future exports; nothing exports from the section itself).
